annotations.title: PDF to text, page by page

description: Download a public PDF (up to 10 MB) and return its text page by page, with title, author, page count and character counts. Choose a first page and how many pages to read (up to 200) and cap the output with maxChars. Scanned PDFs without a text layer, encrypted files and non-PDF URLs fail uncharged. Use to read papers, invoices, reports and manuals into an agent's context. Example: url=https://bitcoin.org/bitcoin.pdf. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of text returned across all pages (1000-200000, default 50000)

pages.description: How many pages to read (1-200, default 50)

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the PDF
